shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- package files ---\\n'; rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'src/orchestration/tools/*' -g 'specs/**' -g 'adrs/**' | sort; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; printf '\\n--- tests ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' package.json; printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n'; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Fix tool input validation error reporting" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
